stops.note: meant 'measure', from a root meaning 'he measures'
became the name of a large unit of weight
stops.meaning: a large traditional unit of weight

stops.note: British India standardized the term as a unit of mass
stops.meaning: a South Asian unit of weight, standardized at about 37 kilograms

current_meaning: A traditional unit of weight used in South Asia, historically standardized at roughly 37 kilograms.
